text:
maya: Quick idea — we should add a first-class console flow for per-customer routing overrides (enterprise exceptions). Need audit trail, TTL, and an explicit reason field so SREs can triage later.

liam: Strong +1. UX: modal with fields: reason, expires_at, owner, emergency flag. Also show who approved on the audit row.

praveen: We also need clear precedence rules. Per-org override should never bypass global security denylists or legal filters. Default: overrides can change routing only, not disable safety checks.

anya: Header-based routing is risky if org headers can be spoofed. We should require either signed headers (HMAC) or an internal short-lived token for API-created overrides. Example header names: `X-Redwood-Org`, `X-RW-Override-Sig`.

maya: Example payload for storing an override in the service layer:
```json
{
  "org_id": "acme-corp",
  "route": "dedicated-gpu-pool-a",
  "created_by": "maya",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "reason": "sales POC - require lower latency",
  "scope": "routing_only",
  "signed": true
}
```

dev-bot: Created ticket PLAT-3124 for signed header design and security review.

liam: Telemetry: emit tags `route_override=true`, `override_source=console|api`, `override_ttl_s`. That lets dashboards break down cost/latency impact by overridden traffic. Also add trace attribute `override_id`.

praveen: For the API: POST /v1/admin/overrides should accept the payload above. Require `admin:override` scope and log `X-Request-Approval` header. All changes must be append-only in the audit store (revoke is a new event, not a delete).

anya: UX request: tenant page should show active overrides inline with a small pill `Override -> dedicated-gpu-pool-a (expires in 2d)` and a link to history. Implement `revoke` button that creates a revocation event and triggers an optimistic revert on the routing layer.

maya: Emergency breakglass idea: allow a temporary bypass that requires two-person approval (2FA + manager). It should set a very short TTL (max 2 hours) and force a postmortem.

liam: Agree. We should also add RBAC checks so only users in `billing_admin` or `platform_ops` can create long-lived overrides.

praveen: One more: when a per-org override is active, rate limit attribution must still apply to the org's quota, not the pool owner. Otherwise billing/quotas get messed up. Add tests for quota attribution in the routing simulator.

maya: I'll prototype the modal + API contract tomorrow. Can @liam and @praveen do a quick review after 10am PT?

liam: Ack, I can review around 10:30am PT.

dev-bot: PR 5421 opened: "console: override modal + backend contract" — CI tests running.

ops-bot: Canary deploy rolling out (routing-service v2.7) to 5% of orgs. No anomalies in logs so far.

maya: Thanks — once PR is green we should sync with Security to confirm HMAC scheme and with Product for the UX copy on the modal (must surface compliance requirements).

praveen: I'll coordinate with Security. Adding follow-up doc in PLAT/docs with the precedence matrix and audit schema.

anya: Cool. Leaving comments on the PR about the revoke UX and showing approver metadata.

maya: Great, meeting after lunch to align on acceptance criteria.
